title: 2026年06月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 在中国传统文化中，亲朋好友之间互赠礼物是人际交往的一种重要礼节 (etiquette) 。赠送礼物不仅是物质的馈赠，更是情感的表达，是维系人际关系的重要纽带。一份精心挑选、符合接受者喜好的礼物，往往能加深彼此的感情。中国人遵循"礼尚往来" (mutually exchanging courtesies)的传统，接受礼物时会表达谢意，并适时回赠礼物，以增进彼此的融洽关系。
referenceTranslation: In traditional Chinese culture, exchanging gifts among relatives and close friends is an important form of etiquette in interpersonal communication. Giving gifts is not only a material offering, but also an expression of affection, and an important bond that maintains interpersonal relationships. Such a carefully chosen gift that suits the recipient's preferences can often deepen mutual affection. Chinese people follow the tradition of reciprocity (mutually exchanging courtesies): when receiving gifts, they express their gratitude and return gifts at an appropriate time, so as to enhance their harmonious relationship.

title: 2026年06月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 餐桌礼仪 (dining etiquette) 是中华传统文化的重要组成部分，蕴含着热情有礼的待客之道。为了招待客人，主人会根据客人的口味和喜好准备丰富精致的菜肴。就餐座位的安排非常讲究，主人坐在正对大门的位置，在主人身边就座的是最重要的客人。进餐时，主人会不时地为客人添酒加菜。这种独特的餐桌礼仪已延续了数千年，对促进和谐的人际交往起到了重要的作用。
referenceTranslation: Dining etiquette is an important part of traditional Chinese culture, embodying the warm and courteous way of treating guests. To entertain guests, the host prepares rich and exquisite dishes according to their tastes and preferences. The seating arrangement is very particular: the host sits in the seat directly facing the gate, while the most important guest sits beside him. During the meal, he refills wine and adds more dishes for the guests from time to time. This unique dining etiquette has lasted for thousands of years and has played an important role in promoting harmonious interpersonal relationships.

title: 2026年06月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 中国有句老话："一日为师，终身为父"。在中国人的观念里，老师不仅传授知识，更教给学生做人的道理。在古代，学生初次见老师时要举行隆重的仪式，足见老师地位之高。为弘扬尊师的优良传统，中国从1985年开始将每年的9月10日定为教师节。在这一天，学生以各种方式表达对老师的敬意。尊师是中华民族的传统美德，在当今社会得到了发扬光大。

hints.en: 本套真题原文无括号提示词，可先尝试整段翻译再对照参考译文

referenceTranslation: There is an old Chinese saying: "A teacher for a day is a father for a lifetime." In the eyes of Chinese people, teachers not only impart knowledge, but also teach students how to be a good person. In ancient times, students had to hold a grand ceremony when they met their teacher for the first time, which was enough to show the high status of teachers. To carry forward the fine tradition of respecting teachers, China has observed September 10 of each year as Teachers' Day since 1985. On this day, students express their respect for teachers in various ways. Respecting teachers is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation, and it has been carried forward in today's society.

title: 2025年12月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 中国政府十分重视绿色经济的发展。通过加强森林资源保护、加大污染治理力度等一系列措施，许多地区的生态环境得到了显著改善。绿水青山 (lucid waters and lush mountains) 促进了当地的旅游、健康等产业的发展，创造了可观的经济效益。如今，生态环境与人类社会和谐共存的观念在中国已深入人心。绿色经济的推进不仅能为中国可持续发展做出贡献，也为全球环境保护提供了宝贵经验。
referenceTranslation: The Chinese government attaches great importance to the development of the green economy. Through a series of measures such as strengthening forest resource protection and intensifying pollution control, the ecological environment in many regions has improved remarkably. Lucid waters and lush mountains have promoted the development of local industries such as tourism and health care, generating considerable economic benefits. Today, the idea that ecology and human society can coexist in harmony has taken deep root in China. The promotion of the green economy not only contributes to China's sustainable development but also provides valuable experience for global environmental protection.
keyPhrases: 绿水青山：lucid waters and lush mountains

title: 2025年12月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 近年来，"城市漫步(city walk)"在中国的年轻人中悄然兴起，已成为一种旅游新潮流。与传统旅游不同，城市漫步不追求在短时间内游览尽可能多的景点。而是随意行走或按照主题路线漫步在城市的大街小巷。漫步者品尝地道小吃，欣赏特色建筑，了解当地生活方式。他们还用相机或手机记录城市的风景和人物。这种旅游方式能让城市漫步者更深入了解城市的历史与文化。
referenceTranslation: In recent years, city walk has quietly emerged among young people in China and has become a new travel trend. Unlike traditional travel, city walk does not seek to visit as many attractions as possible in a short time. Instead, city walkers wander randomly or stroll along themed routes through the streets and alleys of the city. They taste authentic snacks, admire distinctive buildings, and learn about local ways of life. They also record the city's scenery and people with cameras or mobile phones. This travel style enables city walkers to gain a deeper understanding of the city's history and culture.

title: 2025年12月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 近年来，中国政府高度重视民营经济(private economy)的发展，出台了一系列政策支持民营企业。截至 2025 年 3 月底，全国民营企业数量超过 5700 万家，占企业总量的 92.3%。民营企业不仅数量稳步增长，质量和结构也在不断提升。民营企业的研发投入不断增加，在新一代信息技术、人工智能等领域发展迅速。民营企业核心竞争力的增强为中国经济的高质量发展提供了有力支撑。
referenceTranslation: In recent years, the Chinese government has attached great importance to the development of the private economy and introduced a series of policies to support private enterprises. By the end of March 2025, the number of private enterprises nationwide exceeded 57 million, accounting for 92.3% of the total number of enterprises. Private enterprises are not only growing steadily in number but also improving in quality and structure. They are also increasing their R&D investment and developing rapidly in fields such as next-generation information technology and artificial intelligence. As a result, the enhancement of private enterprises' core competitiveness provides strong support for the high-quality development of China's economy.
keyPhrases: 高度重视民营经济：private economy

title: 2025年06月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 近年来，中国越来越多的城市着力打造"15分钟便民生活圈(convenient living circles)"。社区居民步行15分钟就能享受到日常所需的公共服务。生活圈内建有便利店、公园、健身场地、图书馆、学校、社区食堂、诊所等。生活圈的建立能够为居民提供更加便利、舒适、友好、愉悦的生活环境，更好地满足城市居民多元化的日常生活服务需求，提升居民的生活品质和幸福感。
referenceTranslation: In recent years, an increasing number of Chinese cities have been striving to build "15-minute convenient living circles". Within such a circle, community residents can have access to the public services they need in daily life within just a 15-minute walk. There are facilities such as convenience stores, parks, fitness areas, libraries, schools, community canteens and clinics. The establishment of these living circles can provide residents with a more convenient, comfortable, friendly and pleasant living environment, thus better meeting the diverse daily-life service needs of urban residents and improving their quality of life and sense of happiness.
keyPhrases: 分钟便民生活圈：convenient living circles

title: 2025年06月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 近年来，中国东北地区正在大力开发冰雪资源。例如，哈尔滨利用丰富的冰雪资源打造了极具地方特色的"冰雪大世界"，让游客在欣赏冰雪之美的同时也能体验当地独特的民俗文化。如今，曾令人畏惧的冰天雪地正吸引着四面八方的游客，成为深受欢迎的旅游胜地。冰雪旅游业正为当地的经济发展做出越来越大的贡献。

hints.en: 本套真题原文无括号提示词，可先尝试整段翻译再对照参考译文

referenceTranslation: In recent years, Northeast China has been vigorously developing its ice and snow resources. For example, Harbin has built the Ice and Snow World with strong local characteristics by making full use of its rich ice and snow resources, allowing tourists to experience the unique local folk culture while enjoying the beauty of ice and snow. Today, the once-feared land of ice and snow is attracting tourists from all directions and has become a popular tourist destination. Ice and snow tourism is making an increasingly great contribution to the local economic development.

title: 2025年06月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 被誉为"杂交水稻(hybrid rice)之父"的袁隆平和他的科研团队克服重重困难，研发出了一种超级杂交水稻。这项技术获得了举世公认的巨大成功。通过这项技术的应用，水稻抗旱抗病能力更强，能适应不同的气候和土壤条件，产量可提高20-30%。超级杂交水稻营养丰富，口感更佳。目前，这项技术已经在许多国家得到广泛应用，为全球粮食安全做出了重大贡献。
referenceTranslation: Yuan Longping, known as the father of hybrid rice, and his research team, overcoming numerous difficulties, developed a super hybrid rice. This technology has achieved great success recognized worldwide. With the application of this technology, the rice has stronger resistance to drought and disease and can adapt to different climates and soil conditions, and its yield can increase by 20 to 30 percent. In addition, super hybrid rice is rich in nutrition and tastes better. Currently, this technology has been widely applied in many countries, making great contributions to global food security.

title: 2024年12月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 敦煌莫高窟 (Mogao Grottoes) 数字展示中心于2014年开放启用， 是莫高窟保护利用工程的重要组成部分。展示中心采用数字技术和多媒体展示手段， 使游客进入洞窟参观之前就能了解莫高窟的历史文化， 鉴赏莫高窟的艺术经典。这将减少开放洞窟的数量， 缩短游客在洞窟内的逗留时间， 减轻参观对莫高窟造成的影响， 以使这一世界文化遗产得到妥善保护、长久利用。
referenceTranslation: The Mogao Grottoes Digital Exhibition Center, which opened in 2014, is an important part of the project for the protection and utilization of the Mogao Grottoes. The center adopts digital technology and multimedia means, enabling visitors to learn about the history and culture of the Mogao Grottoes and appreciate its artistic classics before they enter the caves. This will reduce the number of open caves, shorten the time visitors stay inside, and lessen the impact of visits on the Mogao Grottoes, so that this World Cultural Heritage site can be properly protected and used over the long term. 第1句已给出全称 The Mogao Grottoes Digital Exhibition Center，第2句再说展示中心时不必重

title: 2024年12月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 近年来，中国新能源汽车产业发展迅速。目前，中国新能源汽车年产量已高达近千万辆，占全球市场份额超过 60%，出口量不断创出新高。中国政府通过加大资金投入和政策引导，鼓励新能源汽车企业进行技术创新，不断提高产品在市场上的竞争力。中国新能源汽车产业的发展不仅有力推动了国内经济发展，也为全球新能源利用和环境保护做出了积极贡献。

hints.en: 本套真题原文无括号提示词，可先尝试整段翻译再对照参考译文

referenceTranslation: In recent years, China's new energy vehicle industry has developed rapidly. At present, China's annual output of new energy vehicles has reached nearly 10 million units, accounting for over 60% of the global market share, while its exports keep hitting new highs. To achieve this, the Chinese government, by increasing funding and providing policy guidance, encourages new energy vehicle enterprises to make technological innovations and continuously enhance the market competitiveness of their products. As a result, the development of this industry has not only powerfully boosted domestic economic growth, but also made positive contributions to the global use of new energy and environmental protection.

title: 2024年12月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 中国政府十分重视环境保护。近年来，中国在减少空气、水和土壤污染上取得了显著成效。为了不断改善人们的生活环境，中国采取了一系列有效措施，包括大力发展清洁能源，改善公共交通，推广共享单车，实施垃圾分类。通过这些措施，中国的城市和农村正在绿起来、美起来。中国还积极参与国际合作，为全球环境保护做出了重要贡献。

hints.en: 本套真题原文无括号提示词，可先尝试整段翻译再对照参考译文

referenceTranslation: The Chinese government attaches great importance to environmental protection. In recent years, China has made remarkable progress in reducing air, water and soil pollution. To continuously improve people's living environment, China has taken a series of effective measures, including developing clean energy, improving public transportation, promoting shared bikes and implementing garbage classification. Thanks to these measures, both urban and rural areas in China are becoming greener and more beautiful. China also actively participates in international cooperation, making important contributions to global environmental protection.

title: 2024年06月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 汉语中的 "福"字 (the character fu)表示幸福和好运，是中国传统文化中最常用的吉祥(auspicious) 符号之一。人们通常将一个大大的福字写在红纸上， 寓意期盼家庭幸福、社会安定、国家昌盛。春节贴福字是民间由来已久的习俗。为了欢庆春节， 家家户户都会将福字贴在门上或墙上， 表达对幸福生活的向往、对美好未来的期待。人们有时还将福字倒过来贴，表示幸福已到、好运已到。
referenceTranslation: The Chinese character "Fu" means happiness and good fortune, and is one of the most commonly used auspicious symbols in traditional Chinese culture. People usually write a large character "Fu" on red paper, expressing their wish for family happiness, social stability and national prosperity. Pasting the character "Fu" during the Spring Festival is a long-standing folk custom. To celebrate the Spring Festival, every household pastes the character "Fu" on doors or walls, expressing their longing for a happy life and their expectation for a better future. Sometimes people also paste the character "Fu" upside down to indicate that happiness and good fortune have arrived.

title: 2024年06月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 农历 (the lunar calendar) 起源于数千年前的中国，根据太阳和月亮的运行规律制定。长期以来，农历在农业生产和人们日常生活中发挥着重要作用。古人依据农历记录日期、安排农活，以便最有效地利用自然资源和气候条件，提高农作物的产量和质量。中国的春节、中秋节等传统节日的日期都基于农历。农历是中国传统文化的重要组成部分，当今依然广为使用。
referenceTranslation: The lunar calendar originated in China thousands of years ago and was formulated based on the movements of the sun and the moon. For a long time, it has played an important role in agricultural production and people's daily life. In the past, ancient people recorded dates and arranged farm work according to the lunar calendar, in order to make the most effective use of natural resources and climatic conditions, thereby improving the yield and quality of crops. The dates of China's traditional festivals, such as the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival, are based on the lunar calendar. As an important part of traditional Chinese culture, the lunar calendar is still widely used today.

title: 2024年06月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 四合院(siheyuan)是中国一种传统的住宅建筑，其特点是房屋建造在一个院子的四周，将院子合围在中间。四合院通常冬暖夏凉，环境舒适，尤其适合大家庭居住。四合院在中国各地有多种类型，其中以北京的四合院最为典型。如今，随着现代城市的发展，传统的四合院已逐渐减少，但因其独特的建筑风格，四合院对中国文化的传承和中国历史的研究具有重要意义。
referenceTranslation: The siheyuan is a traditional Chinese residential building, characterized by houses built on the four sides of a courtyard, enclosing it in the middle. It is usually warm in winter and cool in summer, providing a comfortable environment that is especially suitable for large families. There are various types of siheyuan across China, among which the ones in Beijing are the most typical. Nowadays, with the development of modern cities, traditional siheyuan have gradually decreased; however, owing to their unique architectural style, they remain of great significance to the inheritance of Chinese culture and the study of Chinese history.

title: 2023年12月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 改革开放以来，中国人民生活水平不断提高，这在人们的饮食 (diet)变化上得到充分体现 。如今，人们不再满足于吃得饱，而是追求吃得更加安全、更加营养、更加健康，食物也愈来愈丰富多样，不再限于本地的农产品。物流业 (logistics industry)的发展使人们很容易品尝到全国各地的特产。毫无疑问，食品质量与饮食结构的改善为增进人们健康提供了有力的保障。
referenceTranslation: Since the reform and opening-up, the living standards of the Chinese people have improved steadily, which is fully reflected in the changes in people's diet. Today, people are no longer content with simply having enough to eat; instead, they pursue food that is safer, more nutritious and healthier. Food is also becoming more and more diverse, no longer being limited to local agricultural products. The development of the logistics industry makes it easy for people to taste specialties from all over the country. Undoubtedly, the improvement in food quality and diet structure provides a strong guarantee for improving people's health.

title: 2023年12月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 改革开放以来，中国人的饮食(diet)发生了显著变化。过去由于经济落后，食品种类有限、数量不足 ，人们仅仅满足于吃得饱。如今中国经济快速发展，食品不仅更加丰富多样，质量也大幅提高。随着生活水平不断提升，人们对饮食的要求越来越高，更加注重吃得营养健康。因此，目前市场上推出的低脂、低糖、有机食品受到人们的普遍欢迎。
referenceTranslation: Since the reform and opening-up, the diet of Chinese people has undergone significant changes. In the past, due to the backward economy, food was limited in variety and insufficient in quantity, so people were content with merely having enough to eat. Today, with China's economy developing rapidly, food is not only more abundant and diverse but also greatly improved in quality. As living standards keep rising, people have increasingly higher demands for their diet and pay more attention to eating in a nutritious and healthy way. Therefore, the low-fat, low-sugar and organic food launched on the market today is widely welcomed by people.

title: 2023年12月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 中国政府十分重视人民的健康饮食(diet)。通过大力提倡健康饮食，人们对合理营养增进健康的重要性有了更加深刻的认识。"吃得安全、吃得营养、吃得健康"是人民对美好生活的基本需要，是提升人民幸福感的必然要求，也为食品产业的发展提供了新机遇。目前，各级政府都在采取多种举措确保人民饮食健康，推进健康中国的建设。
referenceTranslation: The Chinese government attaches great importance to people's healthy diet. Through the vigorous promotion of a healthy diet, people have come to better understand the importance of balanced nutrition in improving health. Eating safely, nutritiously and healthily is a basic need of the people for a better life, an inevitable requirement for enhancing their sense of happiness, and also offers new opportunities for the development of the food industry. At present, governments at all levels are taking various measures to ensure people's dietary health and promote the building of a Healthy China.

title: 2023年06月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 中国政府一直大力推行义务教育(compulsory education) ，以使每个儿童都享有受教育的机会。自1986年《义务教育法》生效以来，经过不懈努力，实现了在全国推行义务教育的目标。如今，在中国， 儿童年满六周岁开始上小学， 从小学到初中一共接受九年义务教育。从2008年秋季学期开始， 义务教育阶段学生无须缴纳学费。随着一系列教育改革举措的实施， 中国义务教育的质量也有显著提高。
referenceTranslation: The Chinese government has been vigorously promoting compulsory education so that every child can have access to education. Since the Compulsory Education Law came into effect in 1986, China has, through unremitting efforts, achieved the goal of making compulsory education available nationwide. Today in China, children start primary school at the age of six and receive a total of nine years of compulsory education from primary school to junior high school. Since the autumn semester of 2008, students in the compulsory education stage have no longer had to pay tuition fees. With the implementation of a series of educational reform measures, the quality of compulsory education in China has also improved significantly.
keyPhrases: 大力推行义务教育：compulsory education

title: 2023年06月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 改革开放40多年以来，中国政府对高等教育越来越重视，高等教育已经进入稳步发展阶段。高校学生总数已接近4,700万人，位居世界第一。随着我国经济的快速发展，人民生活水平不断提高，越来越多的人渴望接受高等教育。我国高校的数量和学科专业持续增加，招生人数逐年上升，教学质量也在不断改进，为更多年轻人创造了接受高等教育的机会。

hints.en: 本套真题原文无括号提示词，可先尝试整段翻译再对照参考译文

referenceTranslation: Since the reform and opening-up over 40 years ago, the Chinese government has attached increasing importance to higher education, which has now entered a stage of steady development. Today, the total number of college students has reached nearly 47 million, ranking first in the world. With the rapid development of China's economy and the steady improvement of people's living standards, more and more people are eager to receive higher education. Meanwhile, the number of colleges and universities in China and the disciplines they offer continue to increase, student enrollment rises year by year, and teaching quality is constantly improving, creating opportunities for more young people to receive such education.

title: 2023年06月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 中国越来越重视终身教育，发展继续教育是构建终身教育体系的有效途径。高校作为人才培养的基地， 拥有先进的教学理念和优越的教学资源， 理应成为继续教育的办学主体。因此，近年来许多高校适应社会需求， 加强与用人单位沟通， 努力探索一条符合中国国情的继续教育发展新路， 以使继续教育在国家发展战略中发挥更大的作用。

hints.en: 本套真题原文无括号提示词，可先尝试整段翻译再对照参考译文

referenceTranslation: China attaches increasing importance to lifelong education, and developing continuing education is an effective way to build a lifelong education system. As a base for cultivating talent, universities, possessing advanced teaching philosophies and superior teaching resources, should be the main providers of continuing education. Therefore, in recent years, many universities have been exploring a new path of continuing education that suits China's national conditions by adapting to social needs and strengthening communication with employers, so as to enable continuing education to play a greater role in the national development strategy.

title: 2023年03月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 近年来，越来越多的年轻人喜爱各种形式的自助旅游。许多自助旅游者选择徒步或骑自行车出游。他们自己设计路线，自带帐篷、厨具以及其他必备的生活用品。在旅途中，自助旅游者经常能够发现一些新的美丽景点，但有时也会遇见意想不到的困难或突发事件。游客在旅行中拥抱自然、欣赏美景，同时也增强了自己克服困难的勇气和野外生存的能力。

hints.en: 本套真题原文无括号提示词，可先尝试整段翻译再对照参考译文

referenceTranslation: In recent years, more and more young people have become fond of various forms of self-guided travel. Many self-guided travelers choose to travel on foot or by bike. They design their own routes and bring their own tents, cooking utensils and other daily necessities. During their trips, they often discover some beautiful new scenic spots, but they sometimes encounter unexpected difficulties or emergencies. While embracing nature and enjoying the beautiful scenery, travelers also build up their courage to overcome difficulties and their ability to survive in the wild.

title: 2023年03月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 近年来，越来越多的城市居民为农村的田园风光所吸引，利用节假日到乡村旅游。他们住在农民家中，品尝具有当地风味的农家饭菜。有些游客还参与采摘瓜果等活动，亲身感受收获的喜悦。乡村旅游能够有效地帮助游客舒缓压力，放松心情，增进身心健康。实际上，这种旅游形式不仅能使城市游客受益，同时也能增加农民的收入，促进农村经济发展。

hints.en: 本套真题原文无括号提示词，可先尝试整段翻译再对照参考译文

referenceTranslation: In recent years, an increasing number of urban residents, attracted by the idyllic scenery of the countryside, travel to rural areas on holidays. They stay in farmers' homes and taste home-cooked farmhouse meals with local flavors. Some tourists also take part in activities such as picking fruits, experiencing the joy of harvest firsthand. Rural tourism can effectively help tourists relieve stress, relax themselves, and improve their physical and mental health. In fact, this form of tourism not only benefits urban tourists but also increases farmers' income and promotes the development of the rural economy.

title: 2023年03月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 随着生活水平的提高，更多人开始加入到自驾游的行列之中。自驾游者既可驾驶自家车也可借车或租车出游。司机可能是车主或结伴出游者。自驾游与传统的组团旅游不同，它能够更好地满足旅游者的个性化需求，使他们更好地享受旅游的过程。自驾游尤其受到年轻出游者的欢迎。年轻人追求独立自由的生活，而自驾游恰好满足了他们的这一需求。

hints.en: 本套真题原文无括号提示词，可先尝试整段翻译再对照参考译文

referenceTranslation: With the improvement of living standards, more and more people are joining self-driving tours. A self-driving tourist can either drive their own car or borrow or rent one for the trip, and the driver may be the car owner or a travel companion. Unlike traditional group tours, self-driving tours can better satisfy tourists' personalized needs and thus help them enjoy the travel experience more fully. They are especially popular among young travelers. Young people pursue an independent and free life, while self- driving tours happen to meet this very need.

title: 2022年12月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 冬至(Winter Solstice)是全年白昼最短、黑夜最长的一天，标志着一年中最寒冷时节的开始。冬至过后，气温越来越低，人们的户外活动逐渐减少。农民地里活儿不多，主要忙于灌溉系统的维护和农作物的防冻，同时为来年春天播种做准备。 中国人历来很重视冬至，许多地方都把冬至当作一个节日，庆祝方式各地不尽相同。北方人有冬至吃饺子(jiaozi)的习俗，南方人有冬至吃汤圆(tangyuan)的传统。
referenceTranslation: The Winter Solstice is the day on which daytime is the shortest and night is the longest in the whole year, marking the beginning of the coldest period of the year. After the Winter Solstice, the temperature drops lower and lower, and people's outdoor activities gradually decrease. Since there is not much work to do in the fields, farmers are mainly busy with maintaining the irrigation system and protecting crops from freezing, while preparing for next spring's sowing. Chinese people have always attached great importance to the Winter Solstice and regard it as a festival in many places, though the ways of celebrating it vary from place to place. Northerners have the custom of eating jiaozi on the Winter Solstice, while Southerners have the tradition of eating tangyuan on this day.

title: 2022年12月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 立春 (Start of Spring )在中国农历中表示春天的开始。立春之后， 白天变得更长，天气也愈发温暖，万物开始复苏，大地充满生机。人们常说"一年之计在于春"，农民在这个时节开始播种，为全年的丰收打下基础。中国人早在三千年前就己开始在立春这一天举行庆祝活动。数百年来，迎春一直是民间的重要习俗。在春暖花开的日子里，人们常常外出游玩，欣赏春天的美景。
referenceTranslation: Lichun (Start of Spring) marks the beginning of spring in the Chinese lunar calendar. After Lichun, the days grow longer and the weather becomes warmer; everything comes back to life, and the earth is full of vitality. As people often say, "The whole year's work depends on a good start in spring." At this time of year, farmers start sowing to lay the foundation for a good harvest throughout the whole year. In fact, the Chinese have started to hold celebrations on this day as early as 3,000 years ago. For centuries, welcoming spring has been an important folk custom. Today, on warm spring days when flowers are in full bloom, people often go out for outings to enjoy the beautiful scenery of spring.

title: 2022年12月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 在中国农历中，立秋 (Start of Autumn)意味着夏天的结束和秋天的开始。立秋带来的首先是天气的变化，气温逐渐下降。人们看到树叶开始变黄飘落时，知道秋天已经来临，这就是所谓的"一叶知秋"。但此时酷热的天气并未完全结束，高温通常还会持续一段时间，被称为"秋老虎"。立秋对农民意义重大，这时各种秋季作物迅速生长、开始成熟，收获的季节即将到来。
referenceTranslation: In the Chinese lunar calendar, the Start of Autumn marks the end of summer and the beginning of autumn. It first brings a change in the weather, as temperatures gradually drop. When people see the leaves begin to turn yellow and fall, they know that autumn has arrived; this is the so-called principle that "one falling leaf heralds the coming of autumn." However, the hot weather has not completely ended at this time; high temperatures usually continue for a while, a period known as the "Autumn Tiger." The Start of Autumn is of great significance to farmers, as various autumn crops grow rapidly and begin to ripen at this time, and the harvest season is approaching.

title: 2022年09月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 戏曲是一种中国传统的艺术形式，可以追溯到唐朝。中国戏曲吸引观众的一大特色是其独具风格的脸谱 (facial painting)。脸谱代表不同角色的性格和命运。观众通过观察脸谱能够更好地理解这些角色的故事。欣赏戏曲是中国人特别是老年人的一大乐趣。为了吸引更多的年轻观众，传统戏曲正在不断地发展和创新。如今，越来越多的外国观众也喜欢中国戏曲。
referenceTranslation: Chinese opera is a traditional Chinese art form, which dates back to the Tang Dynasty. A major feature of Chinese opera that attracts audiences is its uniquely styled facial painting. Facial paintings represent the personalities and destinies of different characters. By observing the facial paintings, the audience can better understand the stories of these characters. Appreciating Chinese opera is a major pleasure for Chinese people, especially the elderly. To attract more young audiences, traditional Chinese opera is constantly developing and innovating. Nowadays, more and more foreign audiences also enjoy Chinese opera.
keyPhrases: 其独具风格的脸谱：facial painting

title: 2022年09月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 按照中国民间的传统习俗，春节期间长辈通常会给孩子发红包，俗称发压岁钱 (lucky money)， 以表达对孩子的祝福，祝他们好运。如今，红包不仅是给孩子的礼物，而且经常也是给长辈或亲朋好友的礼物。近年来，随着微信用户数量的增加，微信红包变得愈加流行。欢度春节时，人们经常互发微信红包表达问候。这无疑是一种与远方亲友联系的便捷方式。
referenceTranslation: According to traditional Chinese folk customs, during the Spring Festival the elders usually give children red envelopes, commonly known as lucky money, to express their blessings and wish them good luck. Nowadays, red envelopes are not only a gift for children but also often a gift for the elders, relatives and friends. In recent years, with the increasing number of WeChat users, WeChat red envelopes have become increasingly popular. When celebrating the Spring Festival, people often send WeChat red envelopes to each other to express their greetings. This is undoubtedly a convenient way of staying in touch with relatives and friends far away.

title: 2022年09月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 太极拳 (Taijiquan)起源于中国古代，是中国武术 (martial art) 的一个重要分支。练太极拳最初是为了自卫，现在是促进身心健康的有效锻炼方式。大量研究表明，这种锻炼方式有助于保持力量、灵活性和平衡力，并减少压力和焦虑。太极拳练习起来既容易又愉快，通过轻柔、流畅的动作，促使心情平静、头脑清晰。今天，太极拳已经传播到世界各地，深受广大健身者的喜爱。
referenceTranslation: Taijiquan originated from ancient China and is an important branch of Chinese martial arts. Practicing Taijiquan was originally for self-defense, but it is now an effective form of exercise to promote physical and mental health. A large number of studies show that this form of exercise helps maintain strength, flexibility and balance, and reduce stress and anxiety. Taijiquan is both easy and enjoyable to practice, and with its gentle and flowing movements, it calms the mind and clears the head. Today, Taijiquan has spread to all parts of the world and is widely loved by fitness enthusiasts.

title: 2022年06月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 从前， 有个农夫正在地里耕作， 突然看见一只兔子飞奔而过，撞在一棵大树上死了。农夫毫不费力就吃到了兔肉， 心里非常高兴。他想， "如果总是这样该多好啊!" 于是，他不再耕作， 每天守候在那棵树旁，等待着能再捡到撞死在树上的兔子。他等呀等，等了一天又一天， 田地也荒芜了， 却再也没有等到第二只兔子。人们因而都嘲笑他把偶然当成了必然。

hints.en: 本套真题原文无括号提示词，可先尝试整段翻译再对照参考译文

referenceTranslation: Once upon a time, a farmer was working in his field when he suddenly saw a hare dash by and run into a big tree, where it was killed on the spot. As a result, the farmer got a hearty meal of rabbit meat without any effort and was overjoyed. He thought to himself, "How wonderful it would be if this could happen every day!" From then on, he gave up farming and stayed by that tree every day, hoping to pick up another hare that would crash into it and die. But days passed, his fields gradually became overgrown with weeds, yet no second hare ever came. People therefore laughed at him for taking a chance occurrence as an inevitable one.

title: 2022年06月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 从前有个人养了一群羊。一天早上他准备出去放羊，发现少了一只。他仔细一看，看到羊栏 (sheepfold) 上有个窟窿。显然，夜间有狼钻进羊圈叼走了羊。 邻居劝他修羊栏，可是他不听。 第二天，他发现狼又通过窟窿叼走一只羊。他想起邻居的话，就赶快堵上窟窿，把羊栏补好。此后，他的羊再也没有被狼叼走。 故事告诉我们:出了问题及时补救，可以防止蒙受更大损失。
referenceTranslation: Long long ago, there was a man who raised a flock of sheep. One morning, when he was about to take the sheep out to graze, he found that one of them was missing. On a closer look, he saw that there was a hole in the sheepfold. Obviously, during the night a wolf had got into the sheepfold and carried off a sheep. His neighbour advised him to mend the sheepfold, but he would not listen. The next day, he found that another sheep had been carried off by the wolf through the hole. Remembering what his neighbour had said, he quickly blocked up the hole and mended the sheepfold. From then on, his sheep were never carried off by wolves again. The story tells us that fixing problems in time can prevent us from suffering greater losses.

title: 2022年06月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 从前有个农夫嫌他种的禾苗长得慢，就到地里把禾苗一株株地拔高了一点。回家后他对家人说："今天可真把我累坏了！但我总算让禾苗一下子长高了。"他儿子到地里去一看，禾苗都已死光了。 现在有些家长急于让孩子成功，往往步那个农夫的后尘，搞得孩子苦不堪言，却不见孩子学业长进。这样的家长是否该对这个问题有所醒悟，让孩子自然成长呢？

hints.en: 本套真题原文无括号提示词，可先尝试整段翻译再对照参考译文

referenceTranslation: Once upon a time, a farmer, thinking that the rice seedlings he had planted were growing too slowly, went into the field and pulled them up one by one to make each a little taller. After returning home, he told his family, "I'm really worn out today, but I have finally made the rice seedlings grow taller all at once!" When his son went to the field, he found that all the rice seedlings had already withered. Nowadays, some parents, eager to see their children succeed, often follow in the farmer's footsteps, causing their children great suffering, yet seeing no progress in their studies. Shouldn't such parents wake up to this problem and let their children grow naturally?

title: 2021年12月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 都江堰 (Dujiangyan) 坐落在成都平原西部的岷江上，距成都市约50公里，始建于公元前三世纪。它的独特之处在于无需用堤坝调控水流。两千多年来，都江堰一直有效地发挥着防洪与灌溉作用，使成都平原成为旱涝保收的沃土和中国最重要的粮食产地之一。都江堰工程体现了我国人民与自然和谐共存的智慧，是全世界年代最久、仍在使用、无坝控水的水利工程。
referenceTranslation: Dujiangyan, located on the Minjiang River in the western Chengdu Plain and about 50 kilometers from Chengdu, was first built in the 3rd century BC. Its uniqueness lies in controlling water flow without using dams. For more than 2,000 years, Dujiangyan has effectively served the functions of flood control and irrigation, making the Chengdu Plain a fertile land immune to drought and flood as well as one of the most important grain-producing areas in China. The Dujiangyan project embodies the wisdom of the Chinese people in living in harmony with nature, and it is the oldest water conservancy project in the world that is still in use and controls water flow without a dam.

title: 2021年12月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 坎儿井(Karez)是新疆干旱地区的一种水利系统，由地下渠道将水井连接而成。该系统将春夏季节渗入 (seep into) 地下的大量雨水及积雪融水收集起来，通过山体的自然坡度引到地面，用于灌溉农田和满足人们的日常用水需求。坎儿井减少了水在地面的蒸发 (evaporation)， 对地表破坏很小，因而有效地保护了自然资源与生态环境。坎儿井体现了我国人民与自然和谐共存的智慧，是对人类文明的一大贡献。
referenceTranslation: Karez is a water conservancy system in the arid areas of Xinjiang, formed by underground channels that connect a series of wells. The system collects large amounts of rainwater and meltwater that seep into the ground in spring and summer, and channels them to the surface through the natural slope of the mountains to irrigate farmland and meet people's daily water needs. Karez reduces the evaporation of water from the ground and causes little damage to the surface, and thus effectively protects natural resources and the ecological environment. It embodies the wisdom of the Chinese people in living in harmony with nature, and is a great contribution to human civilization.
keyPhrases: 统将春夏季节渗入：seep into

title: 2021年12月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 大运河 (Grand Canal) 是世界上最长的人工河，北起北京，南至杭州。它是中国历史上最宏伟的工程之一。大运河始建于公元前4世纪，公元13世纪末建成。修建之初是为了运输粮食，后来也用于运输其他商品。大运河沿线区域逐渐发展成为中国的工商业中心。长久以来，大运河对中国的经济发展发挥了重要作用，有力地促进了南北地区之间的人员往来和文化交流。
referenceTranslation: The Grand Canal is the longest man-made river in the world, running from Beijing in the north to Hangzhou in the south. It is one of the most magnificent projects in Chinese history. The construction of the Grand Canal was started in the 4th century BC and completed in the late 13th century. It was originally built to transport grain and was later used to transport other goods as well. The areas along the Grand Canal gradually developed into industrial and commercial centers of China. For a long time, the Grand Canal has played an important role in China's economic development, greatly promoting personnel exchanges and cultural communication between the north and the south.

title: 2021年06月真题·第3套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 龙井(Longjing)是一种绿茶，主要产自中国东部沿海的浙江省。龙井茶独特的香味和口感为其赢得了"中国名茶"的称号，在中国深受大众的欢迎，在海外饮用的人也越来越多。龙井茶通常手工制作，其价格可能极其昂贵，也可能比较便宜，这取决于茶的生长地、采摘时间和制作工艺。龙井茶富含维生素C和其他多种有益健康的元素。经常喝龙井茶有助于减轻疲劳、延缓衰老。
referenceTranslation: Longjing is a kind of green tea produced mainly in Zhejiang Province on the eastern coast of China. Its unique aroma and taste have earned Longjing the title of "China Famous Tea", and it is very popular among the public in China, with an increasing number of people drinking it abroad as well. Longjing tea is usually made by hand, and its price can be extremely high or relatively low, depending on where it grows, when it is picked, and how it is made. In addition, Longjing tea is rich in vitamin C and various other elements beneficial to health. Drinking it regularly helps relieve fatigue and delay aging.

title: 2021年06月真题·第2套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 普洱(Pur'er)茶深受中国人喜爱。最好的普洱茶产自云南的西双版纳(Xishuangbanna)，那里的气候和环境为普洱茶树的生长提供了最佳条件。普洱茶颜色较深，味道与其他许多茶截然不同。普洱茶泡(brew)的时间越长越有味道。许多爱喝茶的人尤其喜欢其独特的香味和口感。普洱茶含有多种有益健康的元素，常饮普洱茶有助于保护心脏和血管，还有减肥、消除疲劳和促进消化的功效。
referenceTranslation: Pu'er tea (also known as Pur'er tea) is deeply loved by the Chinese people. The best Pu'er tea comes from Xishuangbanna in Yunnan Province, where the climate and environment provide the ideal conditions for the growth of Pu'er tea trees. It has a darker color and a taste that is quite different from that of many other teas. The longer Pu'er tea is brewed, the more flavorful it becomes. Moreover, many tea lovers especially enjoy its unique aroma and taste. Pu'er tea contains many elements beneficial to health. Drinking it regularly helps protect the heart and blood vessels, and also helps lose weight, relieve fatigue and promote digestion.

title: 2021年06月真题·第1套 · 翻译真题
sourceText: 铁观音(Tieguanyin)是中国最受欢迎的茶之一，原产于福建省安溪县西坪镇，如今安溪全县普遍种植，但该县不同地区生产的铁观音又各具风味。铁观音一年四季均可采摘，尤以春秋两季采摘的茶叶品质最佳。铁观音的加工非常复杂，需要专门的技术和丰富的经验。铁观音含有多种维生素，喝起来口感独特。常饮铁观音有助于预防心脏病、降低血压、增强记忆力。
referenceTranslation: Tieguanyin, originating in Xiping Town, Anxi County, Fujian Province, is one of the most popular teas in China, and is now widely cultivated throughout Anxi County, while that produced in different parts of the county has its own distinctive flavor. It can be picked all year round, with those picked in spring and autumn being of the highest quality. The processing of Tieguanyin is highly complex, requiring specialized techniques and extensive experience. It contains various vitamins and has a unique taste. Drinking it regularly helps prevent heart disease, lower blood pressure, and improve memory.
